title: Page-stamp operation and the decorate host for headers, footers and watermarks
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib pages and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi decorate header-footer stamps extractable per-page headers and footers and pdfxi decorate watermark stamps extractable text with merged alpha on real fixtures; EDIT-008 and EDIT-009 move to verified.
notes: PageOperation::Stamp/StampPages append an overlay content stream and merge its fonts and ExtGState entries into a direct copy of the page resources under collision-free names; Document::page_frame exposes media box and rotation; the decorate command group hosts the pdfxi-edit header/footer and watermark renderers.
